narr: The remnant circulation of former Pacific Hurricane Kay brought thunderstorms and flash flooding to the Mojave Desert.
ev: Flooding, debris, and road damage closed Hwy 190.
Hwy 168 was flooded at The Narrows.
Badwater Rd was closed due to flooding, debris, and road damage.
Hwy 136 was closed due to mud with a motorcycle stuck.
Hwy 190 was flooded and damaged at and just west of Towne Pass.
Pine Creek Rd was covered with water, boulders, and debris, stranding campers.
Zzyzx Rd was damaged, and Mojave Rd was impassable from Rasor Rd to Kelbaker Rd.
A large amount of water and mud covered Main St at Hinkley Rd.
Both sides of Hwy 395 were flooded near Olancha Ln. Later reports noted large boulders in the road, and stated that the road was flexing from the water.
Hwy 395 was flooded at Lone Willow Dip (in addition to the Olancha Ln flooding also documented in this episode), stranding 50 to 100 cars between the two flooded areas.
Hwy 190 was washed away by a 10 to 15 foot high wall of fast-moving water near Centennial Flats. One truck was swept away; the occupant was unharmed.
Knee high mud was over Hwy 190, and a school bus was stuck in the mud.
Hwy 6 was flooded with water and mud.
